comment: 48yo South-Asian male, daily gutka/pan masala use (tobacco + areca nut + lime preparation) for ~15 years, ~6 pouches/day, placed in buccal vestibule. No tobacco-smoking history. Routine dental exam noted patchy leukoplakia on right buccal mucosa (no biopsy yet). IARC Group 1 carcinogen; gutka users have RR up to ~10 for oral cancer (combined tobacco + areca nut + lime). Fires RF-LIFESTYLE-SMOKELESS-TOBACCO-PREVENTION (relevant_diseases: HNSCC, PDAC, esophageal). Engine routes to PreventionPlan: default = IND-LIFESTYLE-SMOKELESS-TOBACCO-PREVENTION-SURVEILLANCE (cessation pharmacotherapy + oral exam q3-6mo + biopsy any leukoplakia/erythroplakia >2 weeks); alternative = IND-LIFESTYLE-SMOKELESS-TOBACCO-PREVENTION-OBSERVATION (cessation counseling only).
